offer: An AI tool that helps SDR teams research accounts and personalise outreach, so reps book more meetings.

what_they_do.text: Paddle provides a merchant of record platform managing payments, tax, compliance, and billing for SaaS and digital product businesses.

snapshot.text: Paddle is a software development company founded in 2012.
The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom.

news.why_it_matters: Paddle secured $25 million in funding to support international growth and product development.
The launch of the AI Toolkit indicates active product expansion and focus on AI-native customers.

signals.text: Paddle raised $25 million in funding from CIBC Innovation Banking to support international growth.
Paddle launched the AI Toolkit on 20 October 2026 for AI-native and SaaS companies.
The company is actively hiring for Business Development Representative and Senior Account Executive roles.

fit_reasons.text: Paddle is a B2B SaaS company with 430 employees, fitting the ideal size band.
The company is actively hiring sales staff and recently secured a significant funding round.

role_reason: This role oversees the sales team and pipeline generation, aligning with their current hiring efforts.
